args.text:
Batch of 8 runs, all 8 accepted. Flagged: none. Cleared: r01–r08.
- Rigid-body invariance, closure and plane sections were run and passed on every run. No run used the width-free ratio, and none kept a remedy or rolled back.
- The large |z| values in r01–r03 (growth-zone length 695 vs 684 µm) and r05/r08 (flank-difference position 410 vs 421 µm, REGR peak +0.04 %/h) come from a batch MAD near zero. The actual differences are about 11 µm or 0.04 %/h, which is small.
- r07 has a centre REGR peak of 111.61 %/h, about 2.1× the batch median of 53.02. Its flank difference of -13.49 %/h is scaled by the same factor. It was cleared as a faster root: stride 1, no remedies, the same checks as r04/r06, and the same peak position (421 µm), growth-zone length (684 µm) and flank-difference position as the rest of the batch. So the profile has the same shape and a larger magnitude.
- Note: rows r01–r03, r04/r06 and r05/r08 have identical checks and summaries. It may be worth confirming these are separate roots or time windows and not duplicate entries.
- No flagged runs, so no common pattern to report.
